results.title: Ginny Rice wins CIMG award for Fly Dubai campaign

results.title: Stonebwoy featured on soundtrack for Hollywood action comedy ‘Wrong Toes’
results.content: Ghanaian musician Stonebwoy has joined an international collaboration featured on the official soundtrack of upcoming action comedy Boyz Trip, scheduled for worldwide theatrical release in 2027.

results.title: AVAS 2026: Accra to drive Africa’s Tokenisation Agenda
results.content: Ghana will host the Africa Virtual Asset Summit (AVAS) on November 2–3, 2026, as the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Ghana, convenes regulators, policymakers and industry leaders to advance a trusted, inclusive and innovative virtual asset ecosystem across Africa.

results.title: Constitutional reform must deliver institutions that serve Ghanaians
results.content: A judge may be independent on paper and still struggle to deliver justice because a court lacks staff, reliable computers or funds to operate. A public institution may have impressive legal powers yet depend on political goodwill for appointments and resources. These contradictions should be central to Ghana’s constitutional reform debate.

results.title: Forestry Commission plans armed camps to protect Subri Forest Reserve from galamsey
results.content: The Forestry Commission is proposing to establish armed security camps at illegal mining hotspots in the Subri River Forest Reserve in the Western Region to prevent miners from returning to cleared areas.

results.title: 5 inmates reportedly transferred from their cells after alleged plot to poison Wontumi in Nsawam Prison – Aide
results.content: A senior aide to former New Patriotic Party (NPP) Ashanti Regional Chairman Bernard Antwi-Boasiako, popularly known as Chairman Wontumi, says five inmates at Nsawam Prison have been transferred following an alleged plot to poison the politician.

results.title: Motorists’ behaviour improves following sensitisation on TraffiTech – ACP Alexander Obeng
results.content: The Director of Education, Research and Training at the Police Motor Traffic and Transport Department (MTTD), Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Alexander Kwaku Obeng, says the introduction of the TraffiTech-GH initiative and the issuance of caution notices to drivers have contributed to improved road-use behaviour.

results.title: MTN reaffirms commitment to driving Ghana’s digital infrastructure- Group CEO
results.content: MTN Group President and CEO, Ralph Mupita, has reaffirmed MTN's commitment to supporting Ghana's digital infrastructure and digital sovereignty.

results.title: “To serve and to protect beyond borders”: 22 NYPD Officers to embark on landmark humanitarian mission to Ghana
results.content: Twenty-two members of the New York City Police Department are set to trade their precincts for purpose this November, embarking on an eight-day humanitarian journey to Ghana under the banner of the African Law Enforcement Organization (ALEO), a mission that embodies compassion, service, and a steadfast commitment to humanity.

results.title: Daily Insight for CEOs: Preparing for 2027 Board and Executive Conversations
results.content: Effective board and executive discussions begin with clear evidence, honest assessment, and well-defined strategic choices. As CEOs prepare for 2027, they must ensure that discussions about organizational performance and future direction are supported by credible information and a realistic understanding of risks and opportunities. The objective is not merely to present results. It is to create a shared understanding of the decisions, investments, and governance priorities required to move the organization forward.

results.title: What Is Wrong With Us: A continent cannot be built forever in the future tense
results.content: Africa's more than 1.5 billion people have heard every promise a podium can produce. They have been promised industrialisation, jobs, affordable housing, reliable electricity, good schools and modern hospitals at election rallies, inaugurations, investment forums and continental summits. Some of those promises were kept, and others produced real if incomplete progress, but far too many remain suspended somewhere between an eloquent speech and a disappointing site visit. Meanwhile, the mother still walks for water, the graduate still searches for work, the entrepreneur still borrows at punishing rates, and the farmer still watches harvests rot for want of storage and roads. And then, another conference is announced, another declaration is drafted, another photograph is taken, and another round of applause fills the hall. results.title: Woman killed by Tema-Afienya train as residents demand footbridge
results.content: An unidentified woman has been killed after being struck by a passenger train on the Tema-Afienya railway line at Mataheko-Sebrepo, prompting residents to renew calls for a footbridge to provide a safer crossing between communities in the area.

results.content: The Accra Metropolitan Assembly (AMA) has stepped up efforts to reclaim public spaces in the capital, clearing unauthorised structures around the Achimota New Overhead Ayalolo bus stop to improve access for commercial buses and their passengers.

results.title: Dr. Bawumia engages TUC leadership on youth employment, rising living costs and labour welfare
results.content: Former Vice President and NPP presidential candidate, Dr. Mahamudu Bawumia, has taken his broad-based stakeholder engagement to Organised Labour, meeting with the leadership of the Trades Union Congress (TUC) at the Hall of Trade Unions in Accra Tuesday. The meeting, held as part of Dr. Bawumia's ongoing national consultations, brought together top executives of the TUC, the umbrella body representing thousands of Ghanaian workers across both the public and private sectors.

results.title: CDD-Ghana urges NDC to crack down on vote-buying
results.content: The Centre for Democratic Development Ghana (CDD-Ghana) has urged the National Democratic Congress (NDC) to introduce clear rules and stronger monitoring systems to address allegations of vote-buying in its internal elections.

results.content: Former Tamale Central Member of Parliament Inusah Fuseini has cautioned against the growing use of money to influence internal party elections, saying financial inducements threaten electoral integrity even when they fail to determine the eventual winner.

results.title: Northern Ashanti Mines challenges Minerals Commission over Konongo takeover, disputes $8.3m debt
results.content: Northern Ashanti Mines Limited (NAML) has challenged the Minerals Commission’s justification for taking over its Konongo premises, accusing the regulator of making false claims about its debt and mining activities.

results.title: Cenpower clears 600 tonnes of waste from Sega Beach

results.title: Vote-buying: NDC weighs rules to distinguish transport payments from electoral inducement
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) is weighing rules to determine when money given to delegates for transport becomes an electoral inducement.

results.content: Anti-corruption campaigner Edem Senanu has criticised the National Democratic Congress (NDC) leadership for what he considers an inadequate response to allegations of vote-buying during the party’s recent constituency executive elections, warning that the handling of the matter risks damaging the party’s image and ethical standing.

results.title: OWO 2026: The Or Foundation, Reggie Rockstone promote healthy living at Kantamanto

results.title: Oil prices rise after attack on Saudi Arabian refinery reignites supply concerns
